title: CS101: Introduction to Java
description: A comprehensive guide to object-oriented programming using Java. Perfect for beginners.

lessons.title: 1. Variables & Data Types
lessons.content:
Java is a strongly typed language. This means every variable must have a declared type.

Common types:
- int (Integers)
- double (Decimals)
- boolean (True/False)
- String (Text)
